products.title: Roctane Variety Box
products.body_html:
A curated mix of high-performance Roctane products

The Roctane Variety Box gives you a full lineup of GU’s most powerful endurance formulas in one easy package. Whether you’re gearing up for big training days or a long-distance event, this box lets you sample a range of Roctane Energy Gels, Energy Drink Mixes, and Protein Recovery Drink Mixes. It’s ideal for finding your favorite flavors and fine-tuning your fueling plan before your next big push.

products.title: GU Variety Energy Box
products.body_html:
A mix of GU favorites to fuel any activity

The GU Variety Box is the perfect way to sample GU’s best-selling products in one easy bundle. Whether you're new to performance nutrition or just want to mix things up, this box includes a mix of Energy Gels, Energy Chews, Liquid Energy Gels, Energy Waffles, and Hydration Tabs to match your needs across training, racing, or everyday movement. It’s convenient, well-rounded, and made to help you find your favorites while staying fueled from start to finish.

products.title: Liquid Energy
products.body_html:
Smooth Liquid Energy for fast fuel

Liquid Energy delivers all the energy of our Original Gel in a thinner, more fluid format. It goes down easy and hits fast, making it ideal for athletes who want portable carbs with zero fuss. Whether you're mid-effort or between transitions, it's your no-chew, easy-to-sip source of sustained energy.

products.title: Energy Waffle
products.body_html:
Classic flavor meets modern fuel

GU Energy Waffles are now Certified Organic with a new formula for improved texture and taste. Bring one on the go or snack on one pre-workout for a quick tasty energy source. Energy Waffles deliver quality carbohydrates for immediate and long-lasting energy and electrolytes to replenish what's lost when you sweat. The Energy Waffle is made with a layer of delicious syrup between two thin wafers, and it's individually packaged to make it portable and easy to take on the go. Available in a variety of Certified Organic flavors. Select flavors are caffeine free and gluten free.

Campfire S’mores, Salted Caramel, Coffee Caramel and Maple Cinnamon flavors contain: wheat, egg, and soy. May contain milk and coconut.

Wild Berries, Salted Chocolate and Coconut flavors contain: egg and soy. May contain milk and coconut.

Whether you're deep into a long training day or racing through your toughest miles, Roctane helps delay fatigue, support hydration, and protect your muscles so you can go longer, stronger.

products.title: Roctane Magnesium Plus Capsules
products.body_html:
Micronutrient support for endurance and recovery

Roctane Magnesium Plus Capsules are formulated to help endurance athletes stay strong, recover faster, and support overall health. With magnesium, zinc, vitamin D, and vitamin K, this blend works to support muscle function, immune health, and cardiovascular strength. It’s a simple, daily way to cover your micronutrient bases and perform at your best over the long haul.

products.title: Roctane Protein Recovery Drink Mix
products.body_html:
Rebuild stronger after every session

Roctane Protein Recovery Drink Mix is designed to jumpstart your recovery right after a tough workout or race. It delivers high-quality whey protein to rebuild muscle and fast-acting carbohydrates to replenish glycogen stores. With added electrolytes to support rehydration, it’s the all-in-one post-workout shake that helps you recover quicker and come back stronger for the next effort.

products.title: Roctane Electrolyte Capsules
products.body_html:
Replenish what you lose, stay ahead of fatigue

Roctane Electrolyte Capsules are designed to replace key minerals lost through sweat during hard efforts. Each serving delivers sodium, magnesium, and chloride to support fluid balance, prevent cramps, and maintain peak performance. Easy to take and easy to digest, they’re a smart way to supplement your hydration strategy without adding bulk or sugar.

products.title: Hydration Tabs
products.body_html:
Add electrolytes to your water, boost your performance

GU Hydration Tabs transform plain water into a lightly flavored, electrolyte-rich drink that helps you stay hydrated without excess sugar or calories. Each tab dissolves easily and delivers sodium and potassium to support fluid balance and keep your body performing at its best. Whether you're training, recovering, or just staying active, it's a simple way to make your hydration work harder.

products.title: Original Energy Gel
products.body_html:
Quick, portable energy to fuel any effort

GU Energy Gel is your go-to source for clean, fast energy during activity. With a mix of simple and complex carbs, electrolytes, and amino acids, it helps you stay energized, focused, and ready for whatever comes next. Designed for convenience, it’s easy to take, easy to digest, and made to support performance at any level.

products.title: Roctane BCAA Capsules
products.body_html:
Support Your Muscles, Stay Mentally Sharp

Roctane BCAA Capsules help protect and rebuild your muscles during and after intense activity. With a science-backed 4:1:1 ratio of leucine, valine, and isoleucine plus B vitamins, these capsules support recovery, reduce fatigue, and help maintain mental focus when you’re pushing your limits. They’re an easy, efficient way to fuel smart and finish strong.
